package.name: mowgli_coverage_planner
package.description: Coverage-plan action server for the Mowgli mower. Owns PlanCoverage.action and emits a sparse, deterministic CoverageWaypoint sequence covering every working area (outlines + boustrophedon swaths + dock segments) with footprint-aware geometry and atomic per-area .kv checkpoints. Plan 01-05 lands the runtime skeleton; Plan 01-07 fills the validator pipeline + plan builder.
